sets.title: Quick Quiz
sets.description: Choose the correct pronoun form for each sentence

items.prompt: Она ждёт _____. (She is waiting for me.)
items.explanation: Я → меня in accusative. Ждать (to wait for) requires accusative.

items.hint: Рассказать (tell) takes dative for the recipient.
items.explanation: Мы → нам in dative. The recipient of telling is in dative.
Она → её in accusative. No preposition, so no н-.

items.prompt: К _____ пришли гости. (Guests came to them.)
items.hint: К (to) is a preposition. Third person adds н-.
items.explanation: К requires dative. Они → им → ним (after preposition, add н-).

minimalPairs.context: Я думаю о _____. (I'm thinking about him.)
minimalPairs.explanation: After preposition о, third-person pronouns add н-: о нём.

minimalPairs.context: Я знаю _____. (I know her.) - no preposition
minimalPairs.explanation: Without a preposition, use её (no н-).

minimalPairs.context: У _____ нет времени. (She doesn't have time.)
minimalPairs.explanation: After preposition у, add н-: её → неё.
No preposition, so use их (no н-).

fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Choosing between accusative and dative pronoun forms
hints: Написать кому? (Write to whom?) takes dative. No preposition.
explanations: Написать + dative (recipient): они → им (no preposition, so no н-).

sets.title: Sort and Correct
sets.description: Sort pronoun forms and fix errors in pronoun usage

categorySorting.instruction: Sort these pronoun forms by case

errorCorrection.hint: У is a preposition. Third-person pronouns need н- after prepositions.
errorCorrection.explanation: After preposition у, add н-: его → него. Correct: у него.

errorCorrection.hint: Помогать takes dative, and мы is nominative.
The recipient of giving is in dative.
errorCorrection.explanation: Дать кому? (Give to whom?) requires dative: я → мне.

errorCorrection.hint: Звонить takes dative, and они is nominative.

items.prompt: Мама купила _____ подарок. (Mom bought me a gift.)
items.hint: The recipient of buying is in dative.
items.explanation: Купить кому? (Buy for whom?) uses dative: я → мне.

items.prompt: Без _____ нельзя начинать. (We can't start without you. - informal)
Передай _____ привет. (Say hello to her for me.)
items.hint: Передать кому? (Pass to whom?) uses dative. No preposition here.
items.explanation: Передать + dative: она → ей. No preposition, so no н-.

sets.title: Build Sentences
sets.description: Build sentences and practice dative verbs with pronouns
sets.descriptionRussian: Составьте предложения и потренируйте глаголы с дательным падежом

items.prompt: Для _____ это важно. (This is important for you. - formal)
Он думает о _____. (He's thinking about us.)
items.hint: О + prepositional, but for мы the form is нас in this construction.
items.explanation: Думать о ком? uses prepositional, but мы → нас for this form.

items.hint: От is a preposition. Third person adds н-.
items.explanation: От + genitive: она → её → неё (after preposition, add н-).

translation.hint: I = я, see = вижу, them (accusative, no preposition) = их
She = она, came = пришла, to us = к нам

sets.title: Spot the Pattern
sets.description: Recognize the н- rule and case patterns for pronouns
sets.descriptionRussian: Определите правило с н- и падежные формы местоимений

patternRecognition.sentence: у него, к ней, для них, от него
patternRecognition.question: Why do these pronoun forms start with н-?
patternRecognition.explanation: Third-person pronouns (его, её, их, ему, ей, им) add н- when they follow a preposition.

patternRecognition.sentence: меня = acc, меня = gen; тебя = acc, тебя = gen; его = acc, его = gen
patternRecognition.question: What pattern do you notice about accusative and genitive pronouns?
options: They are always the same form
patternRecognition.answer: They are always the same form
patternRecognition.explanation: For all personal pronouns, the accusative and genitive forms are identical.

patternRecognition.sentence: мне, тебе, ему, ей, нам, вам, им
patternRecognition.question: These are all forms of which case?
patternRecognition.explanation: These are all dative forms: мне (to me), тебе (to you), ему (to him), etc.

blanks: Он подарил _____ цветы. (He gave her flowers.)
Без _____ мне грустно. (I'm sad without you. - informal)
Мы купили _____ билеты. (We bought them tickets.)
От _____ пришло письмо. (A letter came from him.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Dative for recipients, genitive after prepositions
hints: Подарить кому? (Give to whom?) uses dative. No preposition.
Без (without) takes genitive. No н- needed for ты.
Купить кому? (Buy for whom?) uses dative. No preposition.
От (from) takes genitive. Third person adds н-.
explanations: Подарить + dative: она → ей (no preposition, no н-).
Без + genitive: ты → тебя (н- rule only applies to 3rd person).
Купить + dative: они → им (no preposition, no н-).
От + genitive: он → его → него (preposition triggers н-).

minimalPairs.context: Я люблю _____. (I love him.) - no preposition
minimalPairs.explanation: No preposition before the pronoun: use его.
After preposition без, third person adds н-: их → них.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I'll call her. (звонить + dative, no preposition)
minimalPairs.explanation: No preposition: use ей (dative of она). Н- only after prepositions.

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: A final round covering all pronoun declension skills
sets.descriptionRussian: Финальный раунд по всем формам местоимений

items.prompt: Я скучаю по _____. (I miss you. - informal)
Это подарок для _____. (This is a gift for them.)
items.promptEnglish: This is a gift for them.
items.hint: Для takes genitive. Preposition triggers н-.
items.explanation: Для + genitive: они → их → них (preposition triggers н-).

items.hint: The recipient of writing is in dative.
items.explanation: Написать кому? uses dative: я → мне.

items.prompt: Между _____ и _____ нет разницы. (There's no difference between you and me.)
items.explanation: Между + instrumental: ты → тобой, я → мной.

errorCorrection.sentence: Без них скучно, я люблю них.
errorCorrection.hint: The second pronoun has no preposition before it.
errorCorrection.explanation: Без них is correct (preposition). But люблю их (no preposition, so no н-).

errorCorrection.hint: Дать кому? takes dative, not nominative.
К is a preposition. Third person needs н-.
errorCorrection.explanation: К + dative: она → ей → ней (preposition triggers н-).
